summary: Scott Belsky is a founder, author and product leader who describes himself on his website as an early-stage angel investor since 2010, focused on consumer, marketplace and interface-driven companies including enterprise and B2B software. His investing page lists early-stage investments such as Clay, EvenUp, Flexport and Liquid Death, and exited investments including Airtable, Pinterest and Superhuman. Check size, stage definition, geography and an application route are not stated; the site publishes a contact email. No personal address is collected.
